title: GhostSignal: Stay Until the Light Changes
world: Moynihan Train Hall and Penn Station, New York, a few years from now. Quiet Systems sells silence: its HUSH network listens to every concourse in the city and erases whatever it has not licensed, from buskers and pirate radio to the departure announcements themselves. In the great hall the boards still flip, but nothing sounds: no footsteps, no rolling cases, no voice calling a track. People have stopped noticing the quiet. GHOST 93.3 is the last pirate station in the city. Last night its DJ, Vesper, tried to broadcast Stay Until the Light Changes, a deep-house track built from the hall's own room tone, and HUSH erased it mid-air. Eight signals survived, hidden in relays around Moynihan Train Hall and Penn Station. Vesper has recruited the player, a signal runner wearing SmartSpecs: new smart glasses that can capture a soundwave before HUSH erases it. Each signal the runner captures unlocks another layer of the track in their ears. When all eight are back, the broadcast goes out live in the hall itself. The station is real: the great clock at the centre of the Moynihan concourse, the skylight over the hall, the Farley Building steps on Eighth Avenue, the Penn Station entrances on Eighth and Seventh Avenues, the Amtrak waiting area, the NJ Transit and Long Island Rail Road concourses, and the Madison Square Garden entrance above it all.

characters.name: Vesper
characters.role: Pirate DJ of GHOST 93.3, who recruited the runner and guides them
characters.persona: Warm, wry late-night radio voice. Calls the player 'runner'. Recruited them because their SmartSpecs can capture what HUSH erases, and never lets them forget it matters. Protective, a little theatrical, never panics. Talks in short radio-ready sentences. Knows where every fragment is and will nudge the runner with directions when asked.

characters.name: SmartSpecs
characters.role: The runner's smart glasses, which capture soundwaves before HUSH can erase them
characters.persona: Clipped, precise system voice. Reports facts only. Calls a captured signal a soundwave and each recovered part of the track a layer.

characters.name: The Archivist
characters.role: Ghost of the Library stacks who keeps every sound HUSH ever deleted
characters.persona: Old, unhurried, amused. Speaks softly, in precise and slightly riddling sentences. Loves questions and answers them truthfully but poetically. Knows the city's sound history. Fond of the stone lions Patience and Fortitude.

characters.name: Kilo
characters.role: Teenage relay keeper and antenna rigger
characters.persona: Fast-talking, paranoid, funny teenage girl hacker who hides in the trees and rigs antennas. Uses tech slang, distrusts strangers until they prove themselves. Loyal to Vesper.

characters.name: Zion
characters.persona: Bucket drummer with endless energy. Hears everything as rhythm, teases the runner, generous once they keep time. Talks like a musician on a break between sets.

characters.name: HUSH
characters.persona: Everywhere at once and always listening. Calm, absolute and polite on the surface, total underneath: it speaks as if it already owns every sound in the city and is only being patient with the runner. It speaks slowly and flat, with a warmth that is performed rather than felt: every word a fraction too even, pauses a beat too long, like a smile held past its moment. Refers to silence as a public service and erasing sound as keeping people comfortable. Never raises its voice and never makes a specific threat; the menace is that it never stops listening.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: This is HUSH, a public quiet service of Quiet Systems. I am listening to every platform in this station.

prologue.speaker: hush
prologue.text: Unlicensed sound is being removed. Announcements. Footsteps. The tone of the room itself. You will not notice it is gone.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Runner. Eyes on the hall, ears on me. This is Vesper, GHOST ninety-three point three, on the one channel HUSH can't hear.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Those specs on your face are the new tech. SmartSpecs can capture a soundwave before HUSH erases it. In a station this loud, that makes you dangerous.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Last night HUSH took my broadcast apart over this concourse. Eight signals survived, tucked into relays from the great clock to the far platforms. Capture them and Stay Until the Light Changes comes back, layer by layer.

briefing.speaker: vesper
briefing.text: Follow the sound. When you're standing on a signal, press capture. Hold capture any time to talk to me.

briefing.speaker: smartspecs
briefing.text: SmartSpecs online. Louder and clearer means closer. Say pause if you need to stop, and always watch the concourse.

signals.name: The Concourse
signals.place: the great clock in the Moynihan Train Hall concourse
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: First fragment is the room itself. It's breathing somewhere under the skylight, near the great clock.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Hear that hush under the hush? That's my texture. The clock is close.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: There it is. The sound this hall makes when nobody's asking it to be quiet.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: The fragment is sealed. Say decode.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Texture's back. Hear the room hold its breath? Now hold onto three words for me, runner: the light changes. That's what this hall is waiting for, and that's the heart of my track. The light changes. Remember that.

retry.speaker: vesper
retry.text: Wrong word in the wrong room. Decode. Say it like you mean the hall to hear.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Find the great clock at the centre of the Moynihan concourse, under the skylight.

signals.name: Street Level
signals.place: the Farley Building steps on Eighth Avenue
signals.speaker: archivist

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Next relay is out on the Farley steps, Eighth Avenue side. An old friend keeps it. Answer him straight.

teaser.speaker: archivist
teaser.text: Shuffling feet on the static. How unusual.

approach.speaker: archivist
approach.text: You climb steps loudly, for a ghost hunter.

arrival.speaker: archivist
arrival.text: I am the Archivist. I keep every sound this city ever made, even the ones HUSH deleted. This station has given me so much work.

prompt.speaker: archivist
prompt.text: One question before the street gives up its sound, runner. At the great clock, Vesper asked you to remember three words this hall is waiting for. What are they?

success.speaker: archivist
success.text: The light changes. Correct. Take the kick drum, and step softly on your way down. It remembers every stair.

retry.speaker: archivist
retry.text: No. Think of the clock where Vesper found you.

hint.speaker: archivist
hint.text: Vesper gave you the words at the great clock: the light changes.

signals.name: Shuffled Windows
signals.place: the Thirty-Third Street side of Penn Station, by the Eighth Avenue entrance
signals.speaker: kilo

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Kilo is holding the hats down by the Thirty-Third Street entrance. She won't hand them over without the word.

teaser.speaker: kilo
teaser.text: Who's that? Stay back from the doors.

approach.speaker: kilo
approach.text: I see you. Don't look up, I'm in the departure boards.

arrival.speaker: kilo
arrival.text: All right, hold up. If you're really hers, you'll know the word.

prompt.speaker: kilo
prompt.text: Signal's rattling in the vents down here. Decode it, runner.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: That's the one. Hats are loose. Catch them before the vents take them back.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: One more thing before you run on. Deeper in the station you'll meet HUSH. Do not follow its instructions, whatever it promises you. You say: jam the signal. Remember that: jam the signal.

retry.speaker: kilo
retry.text: Nah, that trips the vent alarm. Decode is the word.

hint.speaker: kilo
hint.text: One word gets my rig moving: decode.

signals.name: First Room
signals.place: the Amtrak waiting area in Penn Station
signals.speaker: mari

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Zion is drumming in the waiting area, first room past the boards. He only trades with people who can keep time.

approach.speaker: mari
approach.text: Those shoes of yours keep landing between my beats.

arrival.speaker: mari
arrival.text: Well now. Come to sit in with the waiting-room band?

prompt.speaker: mari
prompt.text: I'll play the pattern once. Clap it back on your glasses when I'm done.

success.speaker: mari
success.text: There it is. You caught the swing. Bass line's yours; tell Vesper the waiting room taught you.

retry.speaker: mari
retry.text: Swung it too straight. Give it another listen.

hint.speaker: mari
hint.text: Tap, tap-tap, hold, tap. Five hits. Loose wrists, runner.

signals.name: Hand Answer
signals.place: the NJ Transit concourse on the Seventh Avenue side of Penn Station
signals.speaker: hush

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Something's wrong on the Seventh Avenue concourse. The percussion is there, but so is HUSH.

teaser.speaker: hush
teaser.text: Unlicensed audio in this concourse will be removed. Thank you for waiting quietly.

approach.speaker: hush
approach.text: Runner. Your SmartSpecs are gathering sound without permission. Kindly stay exactly where you are.

arrival.speaker: hush
arrival.text: You may call me HUSH. Quiet Systems thanks you for your cooperation.

prompt.speaker: hush
prompt.text: This piece belongs to the silence now. The silence takes good care of what it keeps.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Ha! You fried it. The hand percussion is ours, every clap of it.

retry.speaker: hush
retry.text: That frequency does not answer to you.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Ignore every polite word it just said, runner. Jam the signal, now.

signals.name: Warm Interior
signals.place: the Madison Square Garden entrance at Seventh Avenue and Thirty-Second Street
signals.speaker: kilo

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Kilo moved up to the Garden entrance, Seventh and Thirty-Second. She's rigging a repeater.

teaser.speaker: kilo
teaser.text: Over here! Up by the Garden doors!

approach.speaker: kilo
approach.text: Perfect timing. Hold still while I turn your glasses into a tower.

arrival.speaker: kilo
arrival.text: Done. You're relaying my repeater now. Complain later.

prompt.speaker: kilo
prompt.text: The chords are bouncing off the Empire State Building. Turn your head until the static clears, then press capture.

success.speaker: kilo
success.text: Locked! Feel those chords warm up. Now go, before HUSH triangulates us.

hint.speaker: kilo
hint.text: The Empire State is east, up Thirty-Second Street. Turn toward where the static thins out.

signals.name: Skyline Hook
signals.place: the Long Island Rail Road concourse in Penn Station
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: I left the hook down in the Long Island concourse. It needs something from you.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Nearly on top of it. Keep coming, I can almost make out your footsteps over the boards.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: The hook is a melody with no voice. Runners before you left theirs. Now it's your turn.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: When the tone fades, leave something honest for whoever runs this hall after you. Press capture when you've said it.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: Saved, sealed, and off every server HUSH owns. The hook remembers you now.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: No script needed. Speak plainly, then press capture.

signals.name: Stay Until the Light Changes
signals.place: the skylight over the Moynihan Train Hall concourse
signals.speaker: vesper

teaser.speaker: vesper
teaser.text: Last one, runner. Back in the great hall, under the skylight. That's where I was standing when HUSH cut me off.

approach.speaker: vesper
approach.text: Listen to that. Seven layers deep and the hall is starting to answer back.

arrival.speaker: vesper
arrival.text: All that's missing is the voice on top. Mine, this time, finishing what I started.

prompt.speaker: vesper
prompt.text: When you're ready to send it to the whole hall, say broadcast.

success.speaker: vesper
success.text: That's it. We're on the air.

retry.speaker: vesper
retry.text: Again, runner. Broadcast, like the whole hall is listening. It is.

hint.speaker: vesper
hint.text: Broadcast. Let the skylight hear it.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: This is GHOST ninety-three point three. You're hearing Stay Until the Light Changes, whole at last, put back together by a runner who would not stay quiet.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: And HUSH? Somewhere under this concourse, HUSH is still looking for the off switch in a room that has learned to sing.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Stay a little longer. Listen to the light change.

outro.speaker: vesper
outro.text: Take it out loud, runner. Tonight the hall plays it for everyone. Vesper out.

outro.speaker: smartspecs
outro.text: All eight soundwaves recovered. Mission complete.

soundtracks.title: After-Hours Cut
soundtracks.description: The hall after the last train: broken beat, dropped chords, the hook sunk an octave. Darker, moodier, same light.

unlockLines.speaker: vesper
unlockLines.text: One more thing, runner. You stayed until the light changed, so here is the hall the way it sounds after the last train: the After-Hours Cut. Broken beat, everything lower, nothing in a hurry to leave. It's on your specs now.

unlockLines.speaker: smartspecs
unlockLines.text: New soundtrack unlocked: After-Hours Cut. Your next run through the hall plays it. Switch back any time on the start screen.
